latest.title: From Bowditch question to Goldman conjecture for type-preserving representations
latest.abstract: For punctured surfaces $Σ_{g,p}$ of genus $g\geqslant 2$, we explore the dynamics of the mapping class group action on the relative $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R})$-character varieties of type-preserving representations. For such relative character varieties, Goldman's conjecture predicts that the mapping class group acts ergodically on their non-Teichmüller components. A related question of Bowditch asks whether every non-elementary type-preserving representation that is non-Fuchsian sends some non-peripheral simple closed curve to a non-hyperbolic element. We show that, on the components of the relative character variety indexed by fixed signs of images of peripheral elements and relative Euler classes non-extremal in the generalized Milnor-Wood inequality, an affirmative answer to Bowditch's question implies Goldman's conjecture.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 在带穿孔且属至少二的曲面上，证明某些保型 PSL(2,R) 相对特征簇分量中，Bowditch 问题的肯定回答推出 Goldman 遍历性猜想。
techniques: 非极端相对 Euler 类
latest.breakthrough: 在固定周边符号与广义 Milnor–Wood 非极端区间内建立两个核心问题之间的逻辑桥梁。
latest.limitations: 这是条件蕴含，并未无条件证明 Bowditch 问题或全部 Goldman 猜想；分量与属数限制不可省略。
latest.priorityReason: 围绕核心猜想给出有用归约，可能指导下一步证明；因仍依赖未解决前提，排在本期无条件突破之后。
